The full contract for this module is defined in ``docs/spec.md``.
Only the Python standard library is used.
"""


class TokenBucket:
    """A token bucket rate limiter.

    Tokens accrue at ``rate`` per second of clock time, up to ``capacity``.
    The bucket never reads the system clock; all time comes from the
    injected ``clock`` callable.
    """

    def __init__(self, rate, capacity, clock):
        if isinstance(rate, bool) or not isinstance(rate, (int, float)) or rate <= 0:
            raise ValueError("rate must be a number > 0 (not a bool)")
        if isinstance(capacity, bool) or not isinstance(capacity, int) or capacity < 1:
            raise ValueError("capacity must be an int >= 1 (not a bool)")
        if not callable(clock):
            raise TypeError("clock must be callable")

        self._rate = rate
        self._capacity = capacity
        self._clock = clock
        self._tokens = 0.0        # the bucket starts empty
        self._ref = float(clock())  # reference time at construction

    def _refill(self):
        """Apply the refill rule and return the currently accumulated amount.

        Accumulates ``elapsed * rate`` tokens since the reference time,
        capped at ``capacity``.  The reference time advances to ``now``,
        but never backwards: a clock that goes backwards behaves as if
        time stood still (no accrual, reference unchanged).
        """
        now = float(self._clock())
        elapsed = now - self._ref
        if elapsed > 0:
            self._tokens = min(float(self._capacity), self._tokens + elapsed * self._rate)
            self._ref = now
        return self._tokens

    def take(self, n=1):
        """Try to consume ``n`` tokens.

        Returns ``True`` and consumes ``n`` if the accumulated amount is
        at least ``n`` (boundary inclusive); otherwise returns ``False``
        and consumes nothing.
        """
        if isinstance(n, bool) or not isinstance(n, int) or n < 1:
            raise ValueError("n must be an int >= 1 (not a bool)")
        if self._refill() >= n:
            self._tokens -= n
            return True
        return False

    def tokens(self):
        """The currently available amount, after applying the refill rule."""
        return float(self._refill())
